The organization is struggling to pay off a £197 million debt incurred during the Covid-era, prompting drastic measures including potential sales of buildings in other European countries.  The British Council maintains it remains committed to its mission but acknowledges the financial challenges and is taking steps to ensure its long-term sustainability.

recent_articles.title: Sebi bars seven entities in social media stock recommendations, alleges Rs 58 crore gains - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sebi**, India's market regulator, has accused seven individuals and a group of entities, including Rohan Gupta and Sharon Gupta, of manipulating stock prices through social media influence. The regulator conducted searches between January 21-24, 2026, after observing unusual trading patterns linked to the group's online activity. **Sebi** alleges that the group accumulated shares before recommending them on social media platforms, profiting from price increases following retail investor participation in those stocks.  The regulator found a significant increase in trade value and profits for the group during the examination period.

recent_articles.title: US spy chief Tulsi Gabbard resigns under pressure from White House: Report - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tulsi Gabbard**, the **US Director of National Intelligence**, resigned from her position to support her husband, who has been diagnosed with an extremely rare form of bone cancer.  She informed **President Donald Trump** of her decision during a meeting in the Oval Office on Friday and plans to leave her post on June 30th. Gabbard acknowledged progress made at the **Office of the Director of National Intelligence**, but stated that there is still important work to be done before her departure.

recent_articles.title: ACB books Medchal deputy collector in disproportionate assets case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB)** officials conducted searches on **Marri Vamshi Mohan**, a Special Grade Deputy Collector, and his associates following allegations of acquiring assets beyond known sources of income. The searches uncovered properties valued at around ₹6.22 crore, including land plots, houses, and vehicles, along with cash and gold ornaments. **Vamshi Mohan** was arrested and remanded to judicial custody.  The investigation is ongoing.
